Subject: The Ridgeline 2P is here — be the first to know when it ships
Preview: 2.1 kg, 3-season ready. Join the waitlist for the Northbay Ridgeline 2P.
Body: Hey,

You've been out enough to know what matters in a shelter: weight you don't notice, weather it can actually handle, and a setup that doesn't eat your last hour of daylight.

The Ridgeline 2P was built around those priorities.

Here's what it is:
- 2-person capacity
- 3-season rating — spring, summer, and fall conditions
- 2.1 kg packed weight
- Ripstop nylon construction

And what it isn't: a 4-season mountaineering tent. If your trip involves sustained winter exposure or technical alpine objectives, this isn't the right tool.

For three-season backpacking and shoulder-season trips where you want real shelter without paying for it in your pack, the Ridgeline fits the job.

We're currently out of stock, but the waitlist is open now. We'll reach out the moment units are available — no pressure, just first access.

Join the waitlist below.

— The Northbay Supply Team
